title: N. Korea denies responsibility for DMZ mine blast, warns of retaliation

blocks.text: North Korea on Wednesday denied South Korea’s announcement that a North Korean mine likely caused a recent blast inside the Demilitarized Zone (DMZ), accusing Seoul of fabricating the findings and warning of “immediate and merciless” retaliation if its troops are fired upon. Kim Yo-jong, the powerful sister of North Korean leader Kim Jong-un, issued the warning in a statement after the South Korean Joint Chiefs of Staff announced Monday that North Korean land mines were “highly likely” to have caused the explosion on Sept. 21 that left three South Korean soldiers injured. “What should not be overlooked is the fact that […]...
